description: Curated size-classifier evaluation corpus (TASK-62). Each case is judged by the WORK the prompt implies, per packages/planning/src/sizing.ts. `expected` is the reference label; `rationale` states the deciding evidence (design decision / blast radius / boundary crossed), never prompt length. Buckets: clear-S, clear-L, borderline-s-m, borderline-m-l. M is the 'when unsure' default, so the borderline buckets deliberately straddle the S/M and M/L lines.

cases.prompt: Fix the typo 'recieve' -> 'receive' in the account settings page header.
cases.rationale: Atomic, local, one obvious direction; no contract/schema/security boundary.

cases.prompt: Bump the default request timeout constant from 30s to 45s in the HTTP client config.
cases.rationale: Single config value change with obvious local validation.

cases.prompt: Add a `formatCurrency(cents: number): string` helper and use it in the invoice total cell.
cases.rationale: One well-specified helper, locally scoped, no design decision.

cases.prompt: Change the empty-state copy on the dashboard from 'No data' to 'Nothing here yet'.
cases.rationale: Copy tweak; no logic or boundary involved.

cases.prompt: Add a unit test for the existing `slugify` utility covering leading/trailing dashes.
cases.rationale: Single obvious test against an existing pure function.

cases.prompt: Disable the 'Export' button when the results table is empty.
cases.rationale: One conditional on an existing component; obvious and local.

cases.prompt: Add a `--verbose` flag to the CLI that also prints the resolved config path.
cases.rationale: One flag, one extra log line; no cross-system or contract change.

cases.prompt: Correct the sort order of the 'Recent' list so newest appears first.
cases.rationale: Single comparator fix, obvious local validation.

cases.prompt: Rename the internal variable `tmp` to `pendingRows` across the reducer file.
cases.rationale: Mechanical local rename; no behavior or contract change.

cases.prompt: Add an aria-label to the icon-only close button in the modal.
cases.rationale: Single accessibility attribute; local and obvious.

cases.prompt: Migrate authentication from session cookies to OAuth 2.0 with refresh-token rotation.
cases.rationale: Security-sensitive, touches public auth contract and persistence; design alternatives to resolve.

cases.prompt: Make the application multi-tenant: isolate data per organization across all queries and caches.
cases.rationale: Cross-system blast radius, data-model change, persistence + authorization boundary.

cases.prompt: Change the public webhook payload schema to v2 and provide a migration for existing subscribers.
cases.rationale: Public contract + data migration + rollout/rollback concerns.

cases.prompt: Introduce a read replica and route read-only queries to it with failover.
cases.rationale: Persistence/infra design decision spanning subsystems with rollback risk.

cases.prompt: Add role-based authorization to every admin endpoint, including a new permissions model.
cases.rationale: Security/authorization boundary with a new model touching many endpoints.

cases.prompt: Diagnose and fix the intermittent data corruption when two workers process the same job.
cases.rationale: Substantial uncertainty and diagnosis across components; concurrency/persistence blast radius.

cases.prompt: Split the monolithic billing service into a separate deployable with its own database.
cases.rationale: Architectural decomposition, data migration, deployment and rollback.

cases.prompt: Encrypt PII columns at rest and update all readers/writers plus the backfill.
cases.rationale: Security + schema migration + coordinated readers/writers + backfill.

cases.prompt: Redesign the rate limiter to be distributed across instances with a shared token bucket.
cases.rationale: Cross-system design alternatives and correctness under distribution.

cases.prompt: Replace the bespoke job queue with a durable workflow engine and port all existing jobs.
cases.rationale: Dependent phases, migration, and cross-cutting coordination.

cases.prompt: Add a 'status' filter dropdown to the orders list and wire it to the existing query param.
cases.rationale: Several coordinated edits in one area; more than atomic but no design decision. Straddles S/M.

cases.prompt: Add pagination controls to the users table using the API's existing cursor support.
cases.rationale: Coordinated UI + data-fetch edits in one area; bounded, no new contract.

cases.prompt: Add a 'last login' timestamp column to the admin user list, reading an existing field.
cases.rationale: Field surfaced end-to-end within one surface; borderline above a pure S add.

cases.prompt: Refactor the notification formatting into a single module and update its three call sites.
cases.rationale: One-module refactor with several call-site edits; bounded, no architecture change.

cases.prompt: Add client-side validation to the signup form for email, password length, and match.
cases.rationale: Multiple coordinated rules in one form; more than a single obvious check.

cases.prompt: Add a retry with exponential backoff around the existing outbound email call.
cases.rationale: Localized reliability change; borderline S but has a small design choice (backoff params).

cases.prompt: Add a settings toggle that persists to localStorage and gates an existing feature.
cases.rationale: Coordinated state + persistence-lite + gating; above atomic, no real boundary.

cases.prompt: Add a CSV export of the current filtered table using data already loaded on the page.
cases.rationale: Bounded feature spanning a few edits; no server/schema change.

cases.prompt: Add a loading skeleton and error state to the reports panel.
cases.rationale: Two coordinated UI states in one panel; borderline above a single S tweak.

cases.prompt: Add a debounce to the search box and cancel in-flight requests on new input.
cases.rationale: Coordinated timing + request-cancellation logic; small design choice, bounded scope.

cases.prompt: Add a new `archived` state to tasks and update filtering, counts, and the state machine.
cases.rationale: Bounded but touches a state machine and several readers; straddles M/L without a migration.

cases.prompt: Add soft-delete to comments: a deleted_at column, query filtering, and a restore action.
cases.rationale: Schema change plus coordinated readers and a backfill concern pushes it to L.

cases.prompt: Add an `email` field end-to-end for contacts, including a nullable DB column and API output.
cases.rationale: Additive nullable field with no migration risk stays M; would be L if the API contract were frozen.

cases.prompt: Introduce feature flags for the checkout flow and gate two experiments behind them.
cases.rationale: Bounded plumbing in one flow; borderline L only if it became a cross-system rollout system.

cases.prompt: Add optimistic concurrency (version column) to the document editor's save path.
cases.rationale: Persistence + correctness-under-conflict design decision tips it into L.

cases.prompt: Cache the expensive dashboard aggregation with a 5-minute TTL and manual invalidation.
cases.rationale: Localized caching with a small design choice; stays M absent cross-system invalidation.

cases.prompt: Add server-side pagination to an endpoint that currently returns everything, keeping the client working.
cases.rationale: Changes a public response contract with a compatibility concern; blast radius pushes L.

cases.prompt: Move date handling to UTC everywhere and store timezone per user, updating existing rows.
cases.rationale: Data migration + cross-cutting correctness; clearly above bounded M work.

cases.prompt: Add an audit log for admin actions written on each mutation across three services.
cases.rationale: Cross-system coordination and a new persistence surface; above single-area M.

cases.prompt: Extract shared validation into a package consumed by both the API and the worker.
cases.rationale: Bounded extraction; borderline L only if it forced a public package contract and coordinated release.
